honors_and_awards.description: In the 2023 challenge (prize giving February '24), I was awarded one of the top individual prizes in the country and a silver medal at Bletchley Park. The National Cipher Challenge is a highly competitive competition run by the leading UK universities for students between the ages of 13-18. The Challenge is focused on developing skills in informatics, problem solving and mathematics.
